parts.name: north_wing
parts.facade: Shipka frontage = the line (-1388,-2812)->(-1325,-2795), ~4-5 m behind the stop pole 1697 and ~10 m from the road centreline; modernist stone-clad slab built 1972-85 with a regular grid of tall rectangular windows; ground floor with several entrances (Palaeontology museum under the north-wing dome, 'Aula Magna' hall at (-1378,-2751))

parts.name: central_block_rectorate
parts.roof: hipped/flat mix; central roof not documented
parts.facade: MAIN FACADE faces west onto Vasil Levski blvd: west face at x = -1424, only ~9 m behind the boulevard kerb. Eclectic, predominantly Baroque forms (Milanov's revision of the 1906 Breancon design). Central 'triumphal arch' parade entrance with a broad staircase, flanked by two lions; between them statues of Socrates and Plato (single source). At the foot of the staircase two seated bronze figures of the donors Evlogi and Hristo Georgiev (sculptor Kiril Shivarov). Sculptural decoration by Mihail Parashchuk, Lyuben Dimitrov and Lyubomir Dalchev. Stained-glass windows inside. Previous model (6 columns + pediment) has no source.

parts.facade: the wing along бул. Цар Освободител (yellow-paved) - 26 m from the B-bus centreline; slanted face towards the Tsar Osvoboditel / Vasil Levski corner; same stone family

landmarks.name: Eagles' Bridge (Орлов мост) with four eagle columns

dimensions.road_direction_over_deck: NW-SE (Tsar Osvoboditel -> Tsarigradsko shosse); the bus crosses at (-1211,-2410)->(-1185,-2385) in A and the reverse in B
dimensions.river: Perlovska, concrete canal ~14 m wide, running ENE under the deck (OSM water + waterline (-1212,-2371)->(-1145,-2419))

column_positions_xz.reading: four OSM 'artwork' nodes exactly at the bridge: two pairs 10.5 m apart ALONG the road axis (NW-SE), the pairs 28 m apart ACROSS it (NE-SW). Pair NE: (-1183.2,-2401.7)+(-1175.5,-2394.6); pair SW: (-1196.1,-2375.7)+(-1203.7,-2382.8). This matches a short stone bridge (~10.5 m between parapet ends over the 14 m canal) with a ~28 m wide roadway. The bus path passes between the pairs, ~14 m from each, so no collision with the carriageway.
